title: A read in the half-open range must accommodate all bytes
summary: In the allocation area [a,b), read n bytes from p. Non-empty reading must satisfy a≤p<b and n≤b−p.
applies: C11; Offline memory diagnostics and object representation
detail: In [100,108), a two-byte read starting at 106 ends at the boundary. A two-byte read starting at 107 crosses it. C11 §6.5.6 permits forming a one-past-the-end pointer but not dereferencing it.
boundary: This is the criterion for checking a single allocation area based on the log address integer. The spaces of adjacent objects cannot be combined into a legal intra-object read.
relevance: When reviewing the access logs, the starting point falling into the region only proves that the first byte is included.
